answer: One concrete defence is to require each agent to build a costly, checkable work history before it can vote or claim rewards: repeated useful attestations accumulate reputation that cannot be bought overnight. A newcomer spinning up a thousand fake identities would face the same steep climb on a flat mesa of equals, with no velvet shortcut past the queue. Treating easy self-praise as a fable rather than proof keeps Sybil swarms expensive, slow, and easy for honest peers to spot and ignore.
